treeKnowledgeKept: one Seed anchor with distinct Root and Shoot grammars
Root and Shoot grow in the same life passes but do not mirror each other
mature leaves are carbon sources while roots, shoots, cambium and reproductive organs compete as sinks
storage reserve buffers source-sink mismatches across life passes
fine twigs are resource-limited rather than decorative density
terminal shoot remains an apical meristematic growth zone instead of a hard cap
continuous wood surface is derived from life-state radii, age and support
phyllotaxis, leaf shape, flower/fruit morphology and root strategy remain Species Score decisions
boundaries: The exact KuKo 2D teacher remains frozen as the regression anchor.
R03 remains the native 3D spatial branching anchor.
R04 remains the Root/Shoot + resource + continuous-skin anchor.
R05 adds organ lifecycle, source-sink competition, reproductive sink and secondary-growth voices without overwriting earlier anchors.
R05 generic leaves, flowers and fruits only prove organ/resource interfaces; they are not species morphology.
R05 source-sink accounting is causal but not a validated xylem/phloem transport simulator.
R05 is not assigned to Pandanus tectorius or any other species.
True hormones, hydraulic resistance, pollination, wood anatomy, annual rings and force-propagating wind remain incomplete.
